pull.title: jobs: add private saved-job shortlist
pull.body:
## Summary
- add a Flyway-backed private `saved_jobs` shortlist with database uniqueness and cleanup constraints
- expose authenticated save/remove/status endpoints plus paginated saved-job listing
- keep save/remove idempotent and only allow currently `OPEN` jobs to be newly saved
- hide jobs that are no longer open from the actionable saved list
- add focused service tests and discovery documentation

## Security / privacy
- bookmarks are scoped exclusively to the authenticated principal
- the API reuses the normal `JobResponse`, so exact/private addresses remain behind the existing participant-only location endpoints
- no public endpoint exposes who saved a job

## Validation
CI should run Maven tests, frontend lint/build, Flyway/PostgreSQL smoke coverage and existing runtime gates. Do not merge unless required checks are green.

issue.title: web: add saved jobs shortlist
issue.body:
## Summary
- expose authenticated saved-job API helpers in the web client
- let signed-in users save open discovery cards through the idempotent backend endpoint
- add protected `/saved-jobs` navigation and a paginated shortlist page
- allow users to remove bookmarks and automatically recover from an emptied trailing page
- reuse privacy-safe `JobResponse` cards and document the web flow

## Safety / privacy
- the shortlist route remains behind the existing authentication guard
- the UI only consumes the existing privacy-safe job response; exact participant-only locations remain untouched
- save/remove operations rely on authenticated, idempotent backend endpoints introduced in #39

## Validation
CI should run frontend lint/build, Maven tests, Flyway/PostgreSQL smokes and the existing runtime gates. Do not merge unless required checks are green.
